mentalism.description: The universe is mental - all phenomena are mental manifestations

correspondence.principle: As above, so below; as below, so above
correspondence.description: There is harmony, agreement, and correspondence between different planes of existence

vibration.principle: Nothing rests; everything moves; everything vibrates
vibration.description: All matter and energy are in constant motion and vibration

polarity.principle: Everything is dual; everything has poles; everything has its pair of opposites
polarity.description: All truths are but half-truths; all opposites are identical in nature, differing only in degree

rhythm.principle: Everything flows, out and in; everything has its tides
rhythm.description: All things rise and fall; the pendulum-swing manifests in everything

cause_and_effect.principle: Every cause has its effect; every effect has its cause
cause_and_effect.description: Nothing happens by chance; chance is but a name for law not recognized

gender.principle: Gender is in everything; everything has its masculine and feminine principles
gender.description: Gender manifests on all planes - physical, mental, and spiritual

emerald_tablet.text: As above, so below; as below, so above. That which is below is like that which is above, and that which is above is like that which is below, to accomplish the miracles of the one thing.
